name: Weak Hashing Algorithm
description: Detects the use of weak hashing algorithms.
recommendation: Use bcrypt or Argon2 instead.

name: Hardcoded Password
description: Detects hardcoded passwords within source code.
recommendation: Store credentials securely using environment variables or a secrets manager.

name: Potential SQL Injection
description: Detects SQL query strings concatenated with dynamic values.
recommendation: Use parameterised queries or prepared statements.

name: Use of eval()
description: Detects the use of JavaScript eval().
recommendation: Avoid eval() and use safer alternatives.

name: Operating System Command Execution
description: Detects the use of child_process functions that execute operating system commands.
recommendation: Validate all user input and avoid executing operating system commands unless absolutely necessary.

name: Hardcoded API Key
description: Detects API keys or access tokens assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Store API keys and access tokens in environment variables or a secrets manager.

name: Unsafe document.write()
description: Detects use of document.write(), which can introduce cross-site scripting risks.
recommendation: Avoid document.write() and use safe DOM manipulation methods.

name: User Input Assigned to innerHTML
description: Detects request or browser input being assigned directly to innerHTML.
recommendation: Sanitise untrusted input and prefer textContent or safe rendering APIs.

name: Potential Path Traversal
description: Detects file reads that use request-controlled paths.
recommendation: Validate and constrain user-controlled file paths to approved directories.

name: JWT Decode Without Verification
description: Detects JWT decoding without cryptographic signature verification.
recommendation: Use jwt.verify() and validate the token signature and expected claims.

name: Weak Random Security Value
description: Detects Math.random() being used to generate security-sensitive values.
recommendation: Use crypto.randomBytes(), crypto.randomUUID(), or another cryptographically secure generator.

name: Disabled TLS Certificate Validation
description: Detects TLS configuration that disables certificate validation.
recommendation: Enable TLS certificate validation and trust only approved certificate authorities.

name: Prototype Pollution from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled objects being merged directly into application objects.
recommendation: Allowlist permitted properties before merging user-controlled objects.

name: Dynamic Module Loading
description: Detects modules being dynamically loaded using request-controlled input.
recommendation: Never construct module paths from user input; use an allowlist of approved modules.

name: Open Redirect from User Input
description: Detects redirects using a destination obtained directly from request input.
recommendation: Validate redirect targets against an allowlist of trusted destinations.

name: Wildcard CORS Origin
description: Detects CORS configuration allowing requests from any origin.
recommendation: Restrict CORS access to explicitly trusted origins.

name: Insecure Cookie Configuration
description: Detects cookies explicitly configured without the Secure attribute.
recommendation: Set Secure on authentication and session cookies when using HTTPS.

name: Weak bcrypt Cost Factor
description: Detects bcrypt hashing configured with an insufficient work factor.
recommendation: Use an appropriate bcrypt cost factor, typically 10 or greater.

name: Shell Execution Enabled
description: Detects child process execution configured to run through a system shell.
recommendation: Avoid shell execution where possible and strictly validate command arguments.

name: Unsafe Object Deserialization
description: Detects use of unserialize() methods that may execute attacker-controlled object data.
recommendation: Avoid unsafe object deserialization and use validated data-only formats such as JSON.

name: Hardcoded Private Key
description: Detects private key material embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Store private keys outside source control using a secure secrets manager.

name: HTTP Basic Authentication Header
description: Detects manually constructed Basic authentication headers.
recommendation: Prefer token-based authentication and ensure credentials are never embedded in source code.

name: Unsafe YAML Loading
description: Detects potentially unsafe YAML deserialization functions.
recommendation: Use safe YAML parsing with schema restrictions and validated input.

name: Insecure HTTP Request
description: Detects outbound HTTP URLs that transmit data without TLS.
recommendation: Use HTTPS for all sensitive network communications.

name: Hardcoded Database Password
description: Detects database password values assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Store database credentials in environment variables or a secrets manager.

name: Hardcoded JWT Secret
description: Detects JWT signing secrets assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Store JWT signing secrets securely outside source code.

name: Disabled CSRF Protection
description: Detects configuration explicitly disabling CSRF protection.
recommendation: Enable CSRF protections for state-changing browser requests.

name: Permissive CSP Wildcard
description: Detects Content Security Policy directives allowing unrestricted sources.
recommendation: Restrict CSP directives to explicitly trusted origins.

name: Sensitive Data Logging
description: Detects potentially sensitive values written directly to application logs.
recommendation: Do not log passwords, tokens, secrets, or other sensitive values.

name: Unsafe Temporary File Path
description: Detects hardcoded temporary file paths that may introduce insecure file handling.
recommendation: Use secure temporary-file APIs with randomized filenames and appropriate permissions.

name: Permissive File Permissions
description: Detects files created with globally writable permissions.
recommendation: Use least-privilege file permissions and avoid globally writable files.

name: MD5 Password Hashing
description: Detects MD5 hashing used in password-related code.
recommendation: Use bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2, or another password-specific hashing algorithm.

name: SHA1 Password Hashing
description: Detects SHA-1 hashing used in password-related code.
recommendation: Use bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2, or another password-specific hashing algorithm.

name: Unvalidated Dynamic Redirect
description: Detects redirects using variables commonly associated with user-controlled URLs.
recommendation: Validate redirect destinations against an allowlist of trusted locations.

name: Disabled HTTP Security Headers
description: Detects Helmet middleware configured with security protections explicitly disabled.
recommendation: Keep appropriate HTTP security headers enabled unless there is a documented requirement.

name: Insecure TLS Version
description: Detects TLS configuration allowing deprecated protocol versions.
recommendation: Require TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3 for encrypted communications.

name: Weak AES Mode
description: Detects use of AES in ECB mode.
recommendation: Use an authenticated encryption mode such as AES-GCM.

name: Hardcoded Encryption Key
description: Detects encryption keys assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Store encryption keys in a secure secrets manager.

name: Unsafe execSync()
description: Detects synchronous operating system command execution.
recommendation: Avoid direct command execution and strictly validate all command arguments.

name: Unsafe spawn with Shell
description: Detects child process spawning with shell execution enabled.
recommendation: Disable shell execution and pass validated arguments directly to the spawned process.

name: Unsafe Dynamic Function
description: Detects use of the Function constructor for dynamic code execution.
recommendation: Avoid dynamically constructing executable JavaScript.

name: Potential NoSQL Injection
description: Detects request input passed directly into common database query filters.
recommendation: Validate and allowlist request fields before constructing database queries.

name: Unsafe JSON Web Token Algorithm
description: Detects JWT verification allowing the none algorithm.
recommendation: Allow only approved cryptographic JWT algorithms.

name: Missing HTTPOnly Cookie Flag
description: Detects cookies explicitly configured without HttpOnly protection.
recommendation: Set HttpOnly on session and authentication cookies.

name: Unsafe Regex Construction
description: Detects regular expressions dynamically constructed from request input.
recommendation: Validate and constrain user input before constructing regular expressions.

name: Potential LDAP Injection
description: Detects LDAP filter strings concatenated with request input.
recommendation: Escape and validate all user input before constructing LDAP queries.

name: Potential XPath Injection
description: Detects XPath expressions concatenated with request input.
recommendation: Use parameterized XPath queries or strictly validate user input.

name: Unsafe File Deletion
description: Detects file deletion using request-controlled paths.
recommendation: Validate and constrain file paths before deleting files.

name: Sensitive Error Disclosure
description: Detects server error responses returning raw exception messages.
recommendation: Return generic client-facing errors and log internal exception details securely.

name: Hardcoded Session Secret
description: Detects session secrets embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Store session secrets in environment variables or a secure secrets manager.

name: Hardcoded AWS Access Key
description: Detects AWS access key identifiers embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Store AWS credentials in environment variables or an approved secrets manager.

name: Hardcoded GitHub Token
description: Detects GitHub-style personal access tokens embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Remove tokens from source code and store them using secure secret management.

name: Disabled Express X-Powered-By Protection
description: Detects explicit enabling of the Express X-Powered-By response header.
recommendation: Disable the X-Powered-By header to reduce unnecessary technology disclosure.

name: Unsafe HTML Insertion
description: Detects use of insertAdjacentHTML which may introduce cross-site scripting when supplied with untrusted content.
recommendation: Sanitize untrusted HTML or use safer DOM manipulation methods.

name: Hardcoded MongoDB Credentials
description: Detects MongoDB connection strings containing embedded credentials.
recommendation: Store database credentials outside source code and construct connection strings securely.

name: Disabled Node TLS Verification
description: Detects disabling Node.js TLS certificate verification through an environment variable.
recommendation: Keep TLS certificate verification enabled.

name: Unsafe Dynamic JavaScript Evaluation
description: Detects dynamic JavaScript execution using setTimeout or setInterval with a string argument.
recommendation: Pass function references instead of executable strings to timers.

name: Unrestricted Multer File Upload
description: Detects Multer upload configuration using a destination without an apparent file filter.
recommendation: Validate uploaded file types, extensions, sizes, and storage destinations.

name: Hardcoded Redis Password
description: Detects Redis connection URLs containing embedded credentials.
recommendation: Store Redis credentials in environment variables or an approved secrets manager.

name: Unsafe Express Static Root
description: Detects serving the filesystem root directly through Express static middleware.
recommendation: Serve static content only from a dedicated application directory.

name: Hardcoded SMTP Password
description: Detects SMTP passwords assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Store SMTP credentials in environment variables or a secrets manager.

name: Hardcoded SMTP Username
description: Detects SMTP usernames assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Store SMTP account details outside source code.

name: Hardcoded OAuth Client Secret
description: Detects OAuth client secrets embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Store OAuth client secrets in secure configuration or a secrets manager.

name: Unsafe Child Process execFile
description: Detects direct use of execFile for operating system process execution.
recommendation: Validate executable paths and arguments before invoking external processes.

name: Unsafe VM Code Execution
description: Detects execution of dynamically supplied JavaScript through the Node.js vm module.
recommendation: Avoid executing dynamically supplied code through the vm module.

name: Unrestricted File Upload Any Type
description: Detects file upload filters that explicitly allow every MIME type.
recommendation: Restrict uploads to an allowlist of approved MIME types and extensions.

name: Hardcoded FTP Credentials
description: Detects FTP URLs containing embedded usernames and passwords.
recommendation: Remove FTP credentials from source code and use secure secret storage.

name: Unsafe XML External Entity Configuration
description: Detects XML parser configuration explicitly enabling external entities.
recommendation: Disable external entity resolution when parsing untrusted XML.

name: Hardcoded Bearer Token
description: Detects Bearer tokens embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Retrieve Bearer tokens from secure runtime configuration rather than source code.

name: Unsafe Dynamic SQL ORDER BY
description: Detects SQL ORDER BY clauses concatenated with dynamic request input.
recommendation: Allowlist permitted sort columns instead of concatenating request input into SQL.

name: Hardcoded Twilio Auth Token
description: Detects Twilio authentication tokens assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Store Twilio authentication tokens in environment variables or a secrets manager.

name: Hardcoded SendGrid API Key
description: Detects SendGrid API keys embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Store SendGrid API keys in secure runtime configuration.

name: Hardcoded Slack Token
description: Detects Slack authentication tokens embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Remove Slack tokens from source code and rotate exposed credentials.

name: Unsafe Dynamic File Write
description: Detects file writes using paths obtained directly from request input.
recommendation: Validate and constrain user-controlled file paths before writing files.

name: Unsafe Directory Creation
description: Detects directory creation using paths obtained directly from request input.
recommendation: Validate directory paths and restrict creation to approved locations.

name: Unsafe File Rename
description: Detects file rename operations using request-controlled paths.
recommendation: Validate and constrain source and destination paths before renaming files.

name: Disabled SameSite Cookie Protection
description: Detects cookies explicitly configured without SameSite protection.
recommendation: Use an appropriate SameSite cookie policy and Secure transport where required.

name: Hardcoded MySQL Connection Credentials
description: Detects MySQL connection URLs containing embedded credentials.
recommendation: Store MySQL credentials outside source code using secure configuration.

name: Hardcoded PostgreSQL Connection Credentials
description: Detects PostgreSQL connection URLs containing embedded credentials.
recommendation: Store PostgreSQL credentials outside source code using secure configuration.

name: Unsafe Dynamic Response Header
description: Detects response header values populated directly from request input.
recommendation: Validate request-controlled values before placing them into HTTP response headers.

name: Hardcoded Stripe Secret Key
description: Detects Stripe secret keys embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Store Stripe secret keys in environment variables or a secrets manager.

name: Hardcoded Firebase API Key
description: Detects Firebase-style API keys embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Store Firebase credentials in secure runtime configuration.

name: Hardcoded Discord Token
description: Detects Discord authentication tokens embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Remove Discord tokens from source code and rotate exposed credentials.

name: Hardcoded PayPal Client Secret
description: Detects PayPal client secrets assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Store PayPal credentials outside source code.

name: Hardcoded Database Username
description: Detects database usernames assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Store database account configuration in secure runtime settings.

name: Unsafe Dynamic SQL LIMIT
description: Detects SQL LIMIT clauses concatenated with request input.
recommendation: Validate numeric limits before including them in SQL queries.

name: Unsafe Dynamic SQL WHERE Clause
description: Detects SQL WHERE fragments concatenated directly with request input.
recommendation: Use parameterized queries instead of constructing SQL WHERE clauses dynamically.

name: Unsafe Dynamic SQL Table Name
description: Detects SQL table names concatenated from request-controlled input.
recommendation: Allowlist valid database table names rather than using request input directly.

name: Unsafe Dynamic SQL Column Name
description: Detects SQL column names constructed directly from request input.
recommendation: Allowlist valid column names before building SQL statements.

name: Unsafe Dynamic RegExp from Body
description: Detects regular expressions constructed directly from request body input.
recommendation: Validate and constrain input before constructing regular expressions.

name: Unsafe Dynamic RegExp from Query
description: Detects regular expressions constructed directly from query parameters.
recommendation: Validate query input before constructing regular expressions.

name: Unsafe Dynamic RegExp from Route Parameter
description: Detects regular expressions constructed directly from route parameters.
recommendation: Validate route parameters before constructing regular expressions.

name: Unsafe Response Cookie from Request Input
description: Detects cookie values populated directly from request input.
recommendation: Validate request-controlled values before storing them in cookies.

name: Unsafe Download Path
description: Detects Express download paths supplied directly from request input.
recommendation: Restrict downloadable files to approved directories and validated paths.

name: Unsafe SendFile Path
description: Detects Express sendFile paths populated directly from request input.
recommendation: Validate file paths and restrict access to approved application directories.

name: Unsafe File Append
description: Detects file append operations using request-controlled paths.
recommendation: Validate and constrain file paths before appending data.

name: Unsafe File Copy
description: Detects file copy operations involving request-controlled paths.
recommendation: Validate source and destination paths before copying files.

name: Unsafe Directory Read
description: Detects directory reads using request-controlled paths.
recommendation: Restrict directory access to approved filesystem locations.

name: Unsafe File Stat
description: Detects filesystem metadata access using request-controlled paths.
recommendation: Validate user-controlled paths before accessing filesystem metadata.

name: Unsafe Symbolic Link Creation
description: Detects symbolic link creation using request-controlled paths.
recommendation: Do not create symbolic links using untrusted path input.

name: Unsafe Process Environment Exposure
description: Detects sending the complete process environment in an HTTP response.
recommendation: Never expose process environment variables in HTTP responses.

name: Unsafe Stack Trace Disclosure
description: Detects raw exception stack traces returned to clients.
recommendation: Log stack traces internally and return generic client-facing errors.

name: Hardcoded Encryption IV
description: Detects initialization vectors assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Generate unpredictable initialization vectors using cryptographically secure randomness.

name: Hardcoded Salt
description: Detects cryptographic salts assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Generate unique salts using a cryptographically secure random source.

name: RSA Key Size Below 2048 Bits
description: Detects RSA key generation configured below 2048 bits.
recommendation: Use RSA keys of at least 2048 bits.

name: Unsafe DES Encryption
description: Detects use of DES-based encryption algorithms.
recommendation: Replace DES with a modern authenticated cipher such as AES-GCM.

name: Unsafe RC4 Encryption
description: Detects use of the deprecated RC4 stream cipher.
recommendation: Replace RC4 with a modern authenticated encryption algorithm.

name: JWT Without Expiration
description: Detects JWT signing configured explicitly without expiration.
recommendation: Set appropriate expiration times on authentication tokens.

name: Hardcoded Session ID
description: Detects session identifiers assigned directly as constant source values.
recommendation: Generate unpredictable session identifiers using the application's session framework.

name: Unsafe Request Data Execution
description: Detects request-controlled input passed directly to dynamic code execution.
recommendation: Never execute request-controlled data as application code.

name: SSRF Through Axios Request
description: Detects request-controlled URLs passed directly to Axios HTTP requests.
recommendation: Validate and allowlist outbound request destinations before making server-side HTTP requests.

name: SSRF Through Fetch Request
description: Detects request-controlled URLs passed directly to the Fetch API.
recommendation: Allow only approved outbound destinations and reject untrusted URLs.

name: SSRF Through Node HTTP Request
description: Detects request-controlled URLs passed directly to Node.js HTTP or HTTPS request functions.
recommendation: Validate outbound URLs and restrict requests to explicitly trusted hosts.

name: Sequelize Raw SQL from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled input passed directly to Sequelize raw SQL queries.
recommendation: Use parameterized Sequelize queries and never pass request input directly into raw SQL.

name: Knex Raw SQL from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled input passed directly to Knex raw SQL queries.
recommendation: Use parameter binding rather than inserting request input directly into raw SQL.

name: Prisma Unsafe Raw Query
description: Detects request-controlled input passed to Prisma unsafe raw query functions.
recommendation: Use parameterized Prisma query APIs instead of unsafe raw queries with request input.

name: MongoDB Where Injection
description: Detects request-controlled input assigned directly to the MongoDB $where operator.
recommendation: Avoid $where with user-controlled data and use validated structured query operators.

name: ORM Mass Assignment from Request Body
description: Detects complete request body objects passed directly to ORM object creation methods.
recommendation: Allowlist permitted fields before passing request data to ORM model creation methods.

name: Dynamic Import from Request Input
description: Detects dynamic JavaScript module imports using request-controlled paths.
recommendation: Use an allowlist of approved modules instead of constructing import paths from request input.

name: Child Process Fork from Request Input
description: Detects Node.js child process fork operations using request-controlled module paths.
recommendation: Never allow request input to determine executable module paths.

name: VM Script from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled JavaScript supplied directly to the Node.js vm Script constructor.
recommendation: Do not execute request-controlled JavaScript through the Node.js vm module.

name: Unsafe Lodash Object Merge
description: Detects request-controlled objects passed directly into deep Lodash merge operations.
recommendation: Allowlist object properties and block prototype-related keys before deep object merging.

name: Dynamic Property Assignment from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled property names used directly in object assignments.
recommendation: Validate property names and reject prototype-related keys before dynamically modifying objects.

name: JWT Expiration Verification Disabled
description: Detects JWT verification configured to ignore token expiration.
recommendation: Enforce JWT expiration and reject expired authentication tokens.

name: Deprecated Crypto createCipher Usage
description: Detects use of the deprecated Node.js createCipher API.
recommendation: Use createCipheriv with a secure algorithm, random IV, and securely managed key.

name: Deprecated Crypto createDecipher Usage
description: Detects use of the deprecated Node.js createDecipher API.
recommendation: Use createDecipheriv with secure key and IV management.

name: Weak PBKDF2 Iteration Count
description: Detects PBKDF2 password derivation configured with fewer than 10000 iterations.
recommendation: Use a sufficiently high PBKDF2 iteration count appropriate to current security guidance.

name: Reflected Request Data in Response
description: Detects request-controlled data returned directly through Express response functions.
recommendation: Validate and safely encode request-controlled content before returning it in HTTP responses.

name: Unsafe JSONP Response
description: Detects request-controlled input returned directly through Express JSONP responses.
recommendation: Validate response content and avoid JSONP when standard JSON responses can be used.

name: Request Controlled Template Rendering
description: Detects Express template names supplied directly from request input.
recommendation: Use only predefined template names and never allow request input to determine template paths.

name: Hardcoded AWS Secret Access Key
description: Detects AWS secret access keys assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Store AWS secret access keys in environment variables or an approved secrets manager.

name: Hardcoded Azure Storage Account Key
description: Detects Azure Storage connection strings containing embedded account keys.
recommendation: Store Azure Storage account keys in secure runtime configuration or a secrets manager.

name: Hardcoded OpenAI API Key
description: Detects OpenAI-style API keys embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Remove API keys from source code and store them using secure secret management.

name: Hardcoded NPM Authentication Token
description: Detects NPM authentication tokens embedded directly in configuration or source code.
recommendation: Store NPM authentication tokens securely and never commit them to source control.

name: Hardcoded Slack Webhook URL
description: Detects Slack incoming webhook URLs embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Store Slack webhook URLs outside source code and rotate exposed webhook credentials.

name: SQL Template Literal Request Injection
description: Detects request-controlled data interpolated directly into SQL template literals.
recommendation: Use parameterized SQL queries instead of interpolating request-controlled values.

name: Sequelize Literal from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled input passed directly to Sequelize literal expressions.
recommendation: Avoid constructing Sequelize literal expressions from request-controlled input.

name: Mongoose Update Mass Assignment
description: Detects complete request body objects passed directly into Mongoose update operations.
recommendation: Allowlist fields that may be updated before passing request data to database operations.

name: Mongoose FindAndUpdate Mass Assignment
description: Detects complete request body objects passed directly into Mongoose find-and-update operations.
recommendation: Allowlist permitted fields before performing model updates with request data.

name: Express Trust Proxy Fully Enabled
description: Detects Express applications configured to trust all upstream proxies.
recommendation: Configure trust proxy only for explicitly trusted proxy infrastructure.

name: Development Environment Forced in Code
description: Detects Express applications explicitly configured to run in development mode.
recommendation: Use production configuration for deployed environments and avoid hardcoding development mode.

name: GraphQL Introspection Explicitly Enabled
description: Detects GraphQL server configuration explicitly enabling schema introspection.
recommendation: Disable GraphQL introspection in production when it is not operationally required.

name: Apollo CSRF Prevention Disabled
description: Detects Apollo GraphQL configuration explicitly disabling CSRF prevention.
recommendation: Keep Apollo CSRF prevention enabled for exposed GraphQL services.

name: GraphQL Playground Enabled
description: Detects GraphQL Playground explicitly enabled in application configuration.
recommendation: Disable interactive GraphQL development interfaces in production unless specifically required.

name: Insecure WebSocket Connection
description: Detects unencrypted WebSocket URLs embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Use secure WSS connections when transmitting application data over WebSockets.

name: Request Controlled Location Header
description: Detects HTTP Location headers populated directly from request-controlled input.
recommendation: Validate and allowlist redirect destinations before setting Location headers.

name: JWT Not-Before Verification Disabled
description: Detects JWT verification configured to ignore the token not-before restriction.
recommendation: Enforce JWT not-before restrictions when validating authentication tokens.

name: Request Controlled JWT Algorithms
description: Detects JWT verification algorithms supplied directly from request-controlled input.
recommendation: Configure a fixed allowlist of approved JWT algorithms on the server.

name: Password Reset Token Returned in Response
description: Detects password reset tokens included directly in HTTP response data.
recommendation: Deliver password reset tokens only through approved secure recovery channels.

name: Sensitive Token in URL Query String
description: Detects URLs containing authentication or security tokens in query parameters.
recommendation: Transmit authentication tokens through secure headers rather than URL query parameters.

name: EJS Template Injection from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled input passed directly to the EJS template rendering engine.
recommendation: Use predefined templates and never treat request-controlled data as executable template content.

name: Pug Template Injection from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled input passed directly to the Pug template compiler.
recommendation: Compile only trusted template content and treat request data strictly as template values.

name: Handlebars Template Injection from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled input passed directly to the Handlebars template compiler.
recommendation: Compile only trusted templates and never compile request-controlled strings.

name: Lodash Template Injection from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled input passed directly to the Lodash template compiler.
recommendation: Do not compile user-controlled input as Lodash templates.

name: Multer Preserve Path Enabled
description: Detects Multer configuration that preserves full paths supplied with uploaded filenames.
recommendation: Disable preservePath and generate server-controlled filenames for uploaded files.

name: Uploaded Original Filename Used in File Path
description: Detects uploaded original filenames used directly when constructing filesystem paths.
recommendation: Generate server-controlled filenames and sanitize uploaded filename metadata before filesystem use.

name: Uploaded File Move Path from Request Input
description: Detects uploaded files moved to destinations obtained directly from request input.
recommendation: Restrict upload destinations to predefined server-controlled directories.

name: World Writable chmod Permission
description: Detects filesystem permission changes that make files or directories globally writable.
recommendation: Apply least-privilege filesystem permissions and avoid globally writable resources.

name: CSP Unsafe Inline Enabled
description: Detects Content Security Policy configuration permitting unsafe-inline content.
recommendation: Avoid unsafe-inline and use nonces or hashes for approved inline resources.

name: CSP Unsafe Eval Enabled
description: Detects Content Security Policy configuration permitting unsafe-eval.
recommendation: Remove unsafe-eval from the Content Security Policy and avoid dynamic code execution.

name: HSTS Maximum Age Disabled
description: Detects Helmet HSTS configuration with a maximum age of zero.
recommendation: Configure HSTS with an appropriate non-zero maximum age for production HTTPS services.

name: Unsafe Referrer Policy
description: Detects Referrer-Policy configuration using unsafe-url which can expose sensitive URL information.
recommendation: Use a restrictive Referrer-Policy such as strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

name: JWT Signed with None Algorithm
description: Detects JWT creation configured to use the none signing algorithm.
recommendation: Sign JWTs using an approved cryptographic algorithm and never use the none algorithm.

name: Plaintext Password Comparison
description: Detects request passwords compared directly against password properties using equality operators.
recommendation: Store password hashes and verify passwords using a password hashing function such as bcrypt or Argon2.

name: Insufficient Crypto Random Bytes
description: Detects cryptographic random byte generation using fewer than sixteen bytes.
recommendation: Use an appropriately sized random value for security-sensitive tokens and identifiers.

name: AES CBC Encryption Usage
description: Detects AES encryption configured in CBC mode, which does not provide built-in authentication.
recommendation: Prefer authenticated encryption such as AES-GCM where appropriate.

name: AES CTR Encryption Usage
description: Detects AES encryption configured in CTR mode without inherent message authentication.
recommendation: Use authenticated encryption such as AES-GCM or provide a secure independent integrity mechanism.

name: Unsafe File Open from Request Input
description: Detects filesystem open operations using paths obtained directly from request input.
recommendation: Validate and constrain request-controlled paths before opening filesystem resources.

name: Unsafe File Truncation from Request Input
description: Detects file truncation operations using paths obtained directly from request input.
recommendation: Allow only validated server-controlled file paths for truncation operations.

name: Unsafe Permission Change from Request Input
description: Detects filesystem permission changes applied to paths obtained directly from request input.
recommendation: Validate filesystem paths and never allow untrusted request data to control permission changes.

name: Unsafe File Ownership Change from Request Input
description: Detects filesystem ownership changes applied to paths obtained directly from request input.
recommendation: Validate filesystem paths and never allow request-controlled data to determine ownership changes.

name: Unsafe File Access Check from Request Input
description: Detects filesystem access checks using paths obtained directly from request input.
recommendation: Validate and constrain request-controlled paths before performing filesystem access checks.

name: Unsafe File Realpath from Request Input
description: Detects filesystem realpath resolution using request-controlled paths.
recommendation: Validate request-controlled paths and restrict path resolution to approved filesystem locations.

name: Unsafe Read Stream from Request Input
description: Detects file read streams created directly from request-controlled paths.
recommendation: Validate and constrain paths before creating file read streams.

name: Unsafe Directory Removal from Request Input
description: Detects directory removal operations using paths obtained directly from request input.
recommendation: Restrict directory removal to validated server-controlled filesystem locations.

name: Unsafe File Descriptor Write from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled data passed directly to low-level filesystem write operations.
recommendation: Validate request data and ensure writes are limited to approved file descriptors and destinations.

name: Unsafe DNS Lookup from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled hostnames passed directly to DNS lookup operations.
recommendation: Validate and allowlist hostnames before performing server-side DNS resolution.

name: Unsafe TCP Connection from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled connection destinations passed directly to Node.js TCP connection functions.
recommendation: Allowlist permitted network destinations before creating outbound TCP connections.

name: Unsafe TLS Connection from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled connection destinations passed directly to TLS connection functions.
recommendation: Validate and allowlist remote destinations before establishing outbound TLS connections.

name: Request Controlled Proxy Target
description: Detects proxy target configuration populated directly from request-controlled input.
recommendation: Use a fixed allowlist of trusted proxy targets rather than request-controlled destinations.

name: Request Controlled CORS Origin
description: Detects CORS origin configuration populated directly from request-controlled input.
recommendation: Validate origins against an explicit allowlist before granting cross-origin access.

name: CORS Credentials with Wildcard Origin
description: Detects CORS configuration combining a wildcard origin with credential support.
recommendation: Use an explicit allowlist of trusted origins when cross-origin credentials are enabled.

name: Cookie Domain Wildcard Configuration
description: Detects cookies configured with an unrestricted wildcard domain.
recommendation: Restrict cookie scope to the minimum required trusted domain.

name: Cookie Path Wildcard Configuration
description: Detects cookies configured with a wildcard path value.
recommendation: Configure cookies with an explicit application path appropriate to their intended scope.

name: Session Cookie Secure Flag Disabled
description: Detects session cookie configuration explicitly disabling the Secure flag.
recommendation: Enable the Secure flag for session cookies transmitted over HTTPS.

name: Session Cookie HTTPOnly Flag Disabled
description: Detects session cookie configuration explicitly disabling the HttpOnly flag.
recommendation: Enable HttpOnly for session cookies to reduce exposure to client-side scripts.

name: Session Regeneration Disabled
description: Detects explicit disabling of session regeneration in application configuration.
recommendation: Regenerate session identifiers after authentication or privilege changes to reduce session fixation risk.

name: Basic Authentication over HTTP URL
description: Detects HTTP URLs containing embedded username and password credentials.
recommendation: Do not transmit embedded credentials over unencrypted HTTP connections.

name: Request Controlled Content Type Header
description: Detects Content-Type response headers populated directly from request-controlled input.
recommendation: Use predefined response content types rather than values supplied by request input.

name: Request Controlled Content Disposition Header
description: Detects Content-Disposition response headers populated directly from request-controlled input.
recommendation: Validate filenames and construct Content-Disposition headers using trusted server-controlled values.

name: Unsafe Archive Extraction Path
description: Detects archive extraction destinations obtained directly from request-controlled input.
recommendation: Extract archives only to validated server-controlled directories and prevent path traversal.

name: Unsafe Tar Extraction from Request Input
description: Detects tar extraction paths or files supplied directly from request-controlled input.
recommendation: Validate archive paths and extraction destinations before processing tar files.

name: Unsafe ZIP Extraction from Request Input
description: Detects ZIP archive extraction using request-controlled destination paths.
recommendation: Restrict ZIP extraction to approved directories and reject traversal sequences.

name: Request Controlled Environment Variable Name
description: Detects request-controlled values used to dynamically access process environment variables.
recommendation: Allowlist permitted environment variable names rather than selecting them from request input.

name: Request Controlled Environment Variable Assignment
description: Detects request-controlled values assigned directly to process environment variables.
recommendation: Do not allow request data to modify application environment configuration.

name: Unsafe Child Process Environment Injection
description: Detects request-controlled data supplied directly as environment configuration for child processes.
recommendation: Construct child process environments from trusted server-controlled values.

name: LDAP Filter Template Injection
description: Detects request-controlled data interpolated directly into LDAP filter template literals.
recommendation: Escape LDAP special characters and construct LDAP filters using validated input.

name: Unsafe HTML Response from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled input returned directly using an HTML response content type.
recommendation: Encode or sanitize request-controlled values before including them in HTML responses.

name: Dynamic HTML Template Literal from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled values interpolated directly into HTML template literals.
recommendation: Encode untrusted values before placing them into generated HTML content.

name: Request Controlled Cache Control Header
description: Detects Cache-Control response headers populated directly from request-controlled input.
recommendation: Use predefined server-controlled cache policies for sensitive application responses.

name: Sensitive Response Cached Publicly
description: Detects Cache-Control configuration explicitly allowing public caching.
recommendation: Avoid public caching for responses containing authentication or sensitive user information.

name: Frame Protection Disabled
description: Detects Helmet frameguard protection explicitly disabled.
recommendation: Enable frame protection to reduce the risk of clickjacking attacks.

name: Content Type Sniffing Protection Disabled
description: Detects Helmet noSniff protection explicitly disabled.
recommendation: Enable X-Content-Type-Options protection to prevent MIME type sniffing.

name: DNS Prefetch Control Disabled
description: Detects Helmet DNS prefetch protection configured to allow browser DNS prefetching.
recommendation: Disable DNS prefetching when unnecessary to reduce unintended hostname disclosure.

name: Cross Origin Resource Policy Disabled
description: Detects Helmet Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy protection explicitly disabled.
recommendation: Enable an appropriate Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy for application resources.

name: Cross Origin Opener Policy Disabled
description: Detects Helmet Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy protection explicitly disabled.
recommendation: Enable Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy unless application functionality specifically requires otherwise.

name: Origin Agent Cluster Protection Disabled
description: Detects Helmet Origin-Agent-Cluster protection explicitly disabled.
recommendation: Keep origin isolation protections enabled unless there is a documented compatibility requirement.

name: Request Controlled SMTP Recipient
description: Detects email recipient fields populated directly from request-controlled input.
recommendation: Validate and restrict recipient addresses before sending application-generated email.

name: Request Controlled Email Sender
description: Detects email sender addresses populated directly from request-controlled input.
recommendation: Use approved server-controlled sender addresses rather than request-provided values.

name: Request Controlled Email Subject
description: Detects email subject fields populated directly from request-controlled input.
recommendation: Validate and sanitize request-controlled email subject values before constructing messages.
